arguments.premise_synthesis: 57% of Americans, including 72% of Gen Z, 65% of Millennials, and 40% of those making $300,000/year, report living paycheck to paycheck, indicating widespread financial fragility.
arguments.conclusion_supported: The widespread prevalence of paycheck-to-paycheck living across income and age groups indicates deep financial strain among households, which is a key indicator of household debt vulnerability.
